children.name: Biebersteinia heterostemon Maxim.
children.description: Biebersteinia heterostemon is a tall perennial herb of the Biebersteiniaceae (Sapindales), reaching 0.4–1.2 m (occasionally over 2 m). It has erect stems and lanceolate 3-subpinnatisect leaves with linear segments up to 1 cm long. The inflorescence is many-flowered with yellow obovate petals, often fascicled in 2–3 flowers. The plant has a characteristic odour and is viscid to the touch. Endemic to the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau and adjacent regions of central China (Gansu, Qinghai, Sichuan, Tibet), it grows on hill slopes, meadows, and gravelly river areas at 1000–3500 m elevation.

children.name: Biebersteinia multifida DC.
children.description: Biebersteinia multifida is a tuberous perennial herb or geophyte up to 70 cm tall, with a woody rhizome 2–4 cm in diameter. Its leaves are finely 3-pinnatisect with linear segments, and the inflorescence is a lax panicle of small pale yellow petals slightly shorter than the sepals. The plant has a characteristic odour and sticky texture. Native to the Middle East and Central Asia — including southeast Turkey, Iran, Iraq, the Caucasus, Lebanon, Syria, Palestine, Jordan, Afghanistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan — it grows in temperate steppe and on dry, rocky slopes at 1000–2000 m.

children.name: Biebersteinia odora Stephan
children.description: Biebersteinia odora is a suffrutescent perennial herb 10–30 cm tall with a stout rhizome ca. 5 mm thick, the upper part densely covered with withered petiole remains. Leaves are nearly basal, 1-pinnatisect with 12–18 pairs of pinnatifid segments, and the inflorescence is a short, few-flowered raceme of nodding yellow (occasionally orange-based) suborbicular flowers. The whole plant is viscid with a characteristic odour. Distributed across Central Asia to southwest Siberia and the western Himalaya (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Xinjiang, Tibet, Mongolia, Pakistan, northern India, Tuva), it grows on scree slopes, rocky gravel, and alpine meadows at 1600–5600 m.

children.name: Biebersteinia orphanidis Boiss.
children.description: Βιότοποç: Στην Ελλάδα, η Biebersteinia orphanidis σχηματίζει μικρούς πληθυσμούς σε ανοικτές θέσεις μέσα ή κοντά σε δάση Abies cephalonica, σπανιότερα σε κλιτύες ορέων πάνω από τα δασοόρια, σε υψόμετρο 1.350 - 1.760 m. Έχει σαφή προτίμηση σε λίγο έως μετρίως επικλινή ελαφρά πετρώδη εδάφη με καλή στράγγιση και συχνά συναντάται στις πλαγιές δολινών στα ασβεστολιθικά όρη που προαναφέρθηκαν, οι οποίες προσφέρουν και προφύλαξη από δυσμενείς καιρικές συνθήκε.
